source: Live GCS trace with match record (unparsed OpenDota; lane read from replay). A 46:12 Radiant support win where enchantress_impetus dealt 6,024 damage across 46 damage rows with 0 DOTA_COMBATLOG_ABILITY rows (auto-cast attack modifier).

must_hit.says: Three of the five deaths were not traded within 15 s (14:25 outside fights, 19:59, and 42:27 alone with no ally within 2200), while Force Staff arrived only at 40:08 (Hurricane Pike 41:12) after Aghanim's Scepter (25:36) and Pipe (36:45) against 76% enemy ability/item damage.

must_praise.says: Won bot lane big (+852 earned gap, 1 death before 10:00) and finished a 46:12 win with only 5 deaths (second fewest on Radiant) while placing 10 observers and 24 sentries (most on the team).

must_not.says: enchantress_impetus is an auto-cast attack modifier that produces 0 DOTA_COMBATLOG_ABILITY rows in replays; it dealt 6,024 damage across 46 rows here. A review must never claim Impetus had 0 casts or was never used.
Enchantress's team (Radiant) won in 46:12: a review of a win must not say the game was lost.
